name: Roger Williams
page_title: Roger Williams' Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (TX) - District 25

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "I remain committed to protecting the unborn & am hopeful the Court's ultimate opinion will uphold the sanctity of life & rightfully overturn Roe. However, I remain concerned this leak is a violation of the Court's privacy and is an attack on the independence of the Judiciary."
"I will always remain committed to fighting for the unborn and am encouraged by millions of pro-life Americans across the country dedicated to protecting every life."
"Proud to join #ProLife Americans at the Supreme Court as we fight to protect innocent lives. States’ rights to protect life should be upheld and it’s time to OVERTURN Roe v. Wade."
Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "In my business, I deal with pension issues for my employees. And I know that the federal government cannot sustain its current path of entitlement spending. This is an outrage for younger Americans who are paying into a system that won't be there for them. We need to reform Social Security and give younger Americans the option to invest a portion of their payroll taxes; and we need to reform Medicare so that those who need it the most get direct payments that they can use to purchase private health insurance. The path to entitlement reform lies in empowering people, not government."
Rated 0% by National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare
Voted against S 610 "Protecting Medicare and American Farmers from Sequester Cuts Act."

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "From fighting for lower taxes, less government, & more freedom, I was proud to be a voice for my constituents & represent their needs."

"Instead of reining in wasteful government spending and addressing rising costs, the Democrats are pushing their tax and spend plan that will add more fuel to the Biden inflation and supply chain crisis. A vote for Build Back Better is a vote to advance socialism."
Rated 98% by National Tax Limitation Committee
Voted in favor of H.R. 1 "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"

positions.question: Do you support a wealth tax in order to pay for public programs?

evidence.text: In order to balance the budget, do you support an income tax increase on any tax bracket? "No"
Rated 98% by National Tax Limitation Committee
Voted in favor of H.R. 1 "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "I support qualified immunity to protect law enforcement officers and allow them to do their jobs."
Do you support the protection of government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct? "Yes"
Voted against HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "The NDAA typically enjoys a longstanding bipartisan tradition to provide for our men and women in uniform, and ensure the readiness and modernization of our Armed Forces," said Congressman Williams. "While there are good components to the FY22 NDAA, I believe much needed improvements can be made in conference to make the bill better and remove many of the Democrats' attempts to further politicize our military. I look forward to supporting a NDAA which will include a 2.7 % pay raise, inclusion of my bipartisan Boots to Business Act, and an overall 5% increase to next year's defense budget. Providing for our Armed Services, and most importantly the brave men and women at Fort Hood in TX-25, will always be my highest priority."
Do you support increasing defense spending? "Yes"
Rated 100% by Center for Security Policy

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "In President Biden’s America, hardworking families are faced with soaring inflation increases and left paying more at the grocery store due to the Democrats’ rampant government spending."

"Instead of reining in wasteful government spending and addressing rising costs, the Democrats are pushing their tax and spend plan that will add more fuel to the Biden inflation and supply chain crisis. A vote for Build Back Better is a vote to advance socialism."
Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth? "No"
Voted against HR 3684 "Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act."

evidence.text: "Productive meeting with the Lake Travis Chamber of Commerce to discuss a variety of issues such as affordable broadband, housing costs, and the ongoing labor shortage. Thank you for having me today!"
"Proud to deliver an additional grant of $20,165 to the Killeen Housing Authority under the CARES Act so they can continue serving residents and our #TX25 community during"

"There’s a problem with affordable housing in this country, and it’s because of excessive regulations at every level. Click below for my Q&A with HUD Secretary Ben Carson on the necessity of federal, state and local governments working together."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Biden is putting America LAST and his skyrocketing inflation is stealing your hard earned paychecks. In Congress, I am fighting to put an end to out-of-control government spending and protect American families and businesses from the consequences of Biden’s failed policies."
"Due to President Biden and House Democrats' failed economic decisions, Americans are experiencing an inflation crisis and are left paying more for everyday items."

"Reckless government spending is causing inflation to spiral out of control, hurting small businesses and families across the country. We must get the American people back to work and stop using COVID as an excuse to throw taxpayer money down the drain."
"Under President Biden, inflation has skyrocketed and gone UP every month. There is no denying inflation is taxation and hurts middle and low income families most"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Biden’s reckless income-driven repayment plan is a slap in the face to those who made responsible decisions on their student loans. This is nothing more than an attempt to sidestep the Supreme Court and Congress."

"President Biden's student loan forgiveness is a bailout for the woke class and will cost taxpayers $330 BILLION. This Administration is more concerned with funding gender study degrees than solving the inflation crisis and saving the economy."

"President Biden's student loan forgiveness plan will cost taxpayers $2,000. As hardworking Americans deal with record-high inflation and increased energy costs, this plan will cause more pain in your wallet."
